name: America class
note: US Navy America-class landing helicopter assault (LHA) ship. Its striking power is the embarked air group (F-35B / AV-8B jets, MV-22 Osprey, and attack/transport helicopters), not ship-launched missiles; the only armament is self-defence (RAM, ESSM, Phalanx CIWS), which is not modelled as offensive weapons. Crew/speed below are estimates.

source.title: America-class amphibious assault ship | Wikipedia
source.note: 'a displacement of about 45,000 long tons (46,000 t)'.

source.title: America-class amphibious assault ship | Wikipedia
source.note: 'They can carry about 20 AV-8Bs or F-35Bs' in the sea-control configuration; a mixed amphibious air group of ~20-25 aircraft is typical.

name: Mistral class
note: French Navy Mistral-class amphibious assault ship (LHD / helicopter carrier). Capability is the embarked helicopter group and landing force; armament is self-defence only (Simbad RAM launchers, small guns), not modelled as offensive weapons. All platform figures below are commonly-cited estimates (specifications table not captured on fetch).

source.note: Top speed commonly cited ~19 kn (~35 km/h). Estimate.
